description: Classifies intentional and false-positive Trivy findings for the repository security scan gate.

intentionalSecurityNegativeFixtures.reason: Scanner self-test fixture that deliberately enables host access, privilege escalation, and unsafe capabilities.

ordinaryConformanceFixtureRules.reason: Authored conformance input; findings remain scanned and reported but the manifest is not a deployable cluster resource.

scannerRuleExceptions.reason: Containers execute with standard non-root POSIX unprivileged UIDs (e.g. 1000, 1001, 65532, 65534) under runAsNonRoot: true; requiring UID > 10000 conflicts with standard distroless/container user conventions.
